title: Lazar said in 1989 that the craft were intact and the Navy was in charge

tellings.quote: Bob Lazar comes out in 1989 and says they weren't crash saucers, they were intact craft. And it's the Navy that's in charge.

plain: Back in 1989, a man named Bob Lazar went public saying he had worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S4, and that the craft were not crashed saucers but intact ones, with the Navy in charge rather than the Air Force. A researcher named Luigi Vendittelli tells this on the show, summarising what Lazar said. He tells it because it breaks from the usual story of crashed saucers picked up by the Air Force.
